test_title: PYST 15: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All classes are tools.

Some tools are nails.

No nail is a class.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some classes are nails.

(II) All tools are classes.

(III) Some nails are tools.

options.text: All conclusions I, II and III follow
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a445e4ac8fe2405cdbf4c965ca878c704edf86014c40a88de0c3f208bb269882.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some classes are nails. → Does not follow (As, No nail is a classes, so Some classes are not nails)

(II) All tools are classes. → Does not follow (As, All classes are tools, so some tools are classes)

(III) Some nails are tools. → Follows (As, Some tools are nails, so Some nails are tools)

Hence, '**Only conclusion III follows**' is the correct answer.
